programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: 'S8/E3 - Desert Killers'. The dunes and deserts of Africa are a land where only the toughest can survive - through wits, brawn and true killer talents, these are some of Africa's deadliest.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest

programme.title: Snakes In The City
